facts.business: Kiduja India Limited is a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC-ICC) registered with RBI, specialising in investment and dealing in shares and securities listed on Indian stock exchanges.

segments.name: Investment and dealing in Shares and Securities

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty related to Going Concern: The Company has been incurring losses for the past few years, its net worth has been fully eroded, and financial liabilities exceeded financial assets as on 31st March 2026. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on promoter comfort for continued financial support.

key_risks: Volatility in domestic and global financial markets
Economic uncertainty and macro-economic factors affecting investment portfolio value and returns
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to eroded net worth and financial liabilities exceeding financial assets
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured loans from related parties: Rs. 1,22,843.83 thousand bearing interest at 6.25% p.a. and Rs. 87,000.00 thousand interest-free, repayable by 30th September 2026. Secured loan from Aditya Birla Finance Limited secured by pledge of company securities, equitable mortgage of immovable property of associate M/s. Jaipuria Residency Pvt. Ltd, and personal guarantee of Managing Director.
